content:
anya: Quick heads-up from onboarding q4k-kraken: mixed KR+ZH inputs show spacing injected between Han ideographs in quant path, BLEU locally down ~6 vs fp16. Anyone else? :confused:

mike: oof. can you paste minimal example and tokenizer detoks?

anya: example:
`KR: \uadf8\ub294 \uc11c\uc6b8\uc5d0 \uac14\ub2e4. ZH: \u4ed6\u53bb\u4e86\u9996\u5c14\u3002` -> translate en

chen: quick token dump shows extra split tokens in quantized vocab-remap path. detok becomes: "... \u4ed6\u53bb\u4e86 \u9996 \u5c14 \u3002" (spaces around name) vs baseline no spaces.

hiro: could be remap thresholds or merge kernel for q4_k. did you try forcing legacy tokenizer?

mike: forced legacy tokenizer and BLEU returns to -0.3 range. so suspect runtime remap/kernel.

eval-bot: auto-eval summary: mixed-kr-zh n=1200 -> BLEU fp16=33.1 q4k=27.2 delta -5.9; chrF delta -0.041; token-split +2.4% (report s3://redwood-evals/1748888888/krzh-quant.html)

anya: plan: implement a small compatibility shim that preserves CJK merge behavior when remapping vocab for q4_k instead of reverting perf kernel. i'll open PR `fix/quant-cjk-merge-shim` and add regression tests + canary job. tagging @chen @mike for review.

chen: i'll add unit+integration tests to perf harness and a canary check that fails if BLEU delta < -1.5 on mixed set.

hiro: sounds good. keep the perf improvements but protect locales. also add a short doc note in onboard checklist about running mixed-multilingual smoke for quant builds.

mike: FYI the kernel gives ~3% latency win, so shim approach is ideal. thanks :thumbsup:

anya: opening ticket and PR now, will link artifacts when ready.
